claims: The 2026 NFL Draft takes place in Pittsburgh, Pa.
The 2026 NFL Draft takes place from Thursday, April 23 to Saturday, April 25.
The 2026 NFL Draft is the 91st annual event.
The 2026 NFL Draft features 32 first-round selections.
The 2026 NFL Draft will be broadcast on NFL Network, ABC, ESPN, ESPN2, and ESPN Deportes.
The first round of the 2026 NFL Draft is at 8 p.m. ET on Thursday.
Top prospects for the 2026 NFL Draft include Miami DE Akheem Mesidor.
Top prospects for the 2026 NFL Draft include QB Julian Sayin
